caseName: Washington County v. United States ex rel. Mortimer
caseNameFull: WASHINGTON COUNTY v. UNITED STATES ex rel. MORTIMER
summary: ERROR TO THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE DISTRICT OF IOWA.
attorneys: Mr. H. Strong for plaintiffs in error., Mr. James Qramt for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Strong
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Strong

delivered the opinion of the court.

This case differs in no essential particular from No. 133 decided at this term. For the reasons given in the opinion filed in that case this judgment must be affirmed.

The judgment of the Circuit Court is Affirmed with costs.
